notes.title: Ghosts, Questions, and a Little Update
notes.content:
Hello again,

This one’s short but spooky 👻

A Story of Questions is now part of the Hungry Ghost Festival on Steam!
It’s a special event highlighting haunting, atmospheric horror games, so if you’ve been thinking about wishlisting, now’s a perfect time.


[previewyoutube="F_T6DPRoCJ8;full"][/previewyoutube]A Quiet Month…
You may have noticed it’s been a little quiet around here. That’s because I’ve been working away on something special for the game. I can’t share details just yet, but let’s just say it’s bigger than a plush duck this time 😉



Every Choice Still Matters

In case you’re new here:
A Story of Questions is a narrative-driven horror mystery about choices.
Small ones, like opening a box or playing a tape.
Bigger ones, like answering a question that may change everything.
Every choice closes a door… and opens another.#



What’s Next?

For now, I’ll keep building in the background, but I wanted to drop by, share the event, and say thank you for sticking with me even when things get quiet.

Your support (and wishlists) mean the world 💛

👉 The Hungry Ghost Festival Event Link



Until next time,

- Tim

Under the Bridge Games

notes.title: “A Story of Questions” is part of Games Forged in Germany! 🇩🇪
notes.content:
We're thrilled to share that A Story of Questions is featured in the Games Forged in Germany event.

This special showcase highlights unique and creative games developed in Germany and as a solo dev, I’m incredibly proud to be part of it.

If you're discovering the game for the first time:
A Story of Questions is a narrative-driven horror mystery where every choice matters. You're stuck at a desk. The lights flicker. The ducks are watching. And all you can do… is answer.

🔍 Explore strange objects.
🖱️ Interact with your environment in ways you might not expect.
🦆 And yes… there are ducks. If you make the right decisions.


[previewyoutube="F_T6DPRoCJ8;full"][/previewyoutube]

📝 Add the game to your wishlist,
💬 Or drop by the comments and let me know what you’d do if your only way forward was to answer a question.

👉 Don’t forget to check out the full Games Forged in Germany lineup too  there are some fantastic titles in there! Games Forged in Germany Event Link

Thank you so much for the support and welcome to everyone who found the game through the event!

🖤
- Tim (Under the Bridge Games)
